name: Serghei Spivac
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Moldovan heavyweight grappler (18-7, age 31) who has alternated wins and losses: a decision win over Ante Delija in February and a decision loss to Vitor Petrino in August.

how_they_fight.Striking: Serviceable boxing; seven knockouts in our data, five of them in R1.
how_they_fight.Grappling: His weapon: takes opponents down and finishes with arm-triangles and ground strikes. Eight submissions (six in R1).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped four times by strikes, three of them in R1 (Gane in R2).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fades in long exchanges; recent fights have gone the distance (Delija, Petrino, Cortes-Acosta).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Wins when he gets an early takedown; struggles against heavy strikers who stuff the first shot.

concerns: Stopped by strikes four times, mostly in R1
Against a long, unbeaten knockout puncher
keys_to_beat: Stuff the first takedown and make him strike

sources.author: Mike Heck
